notes.title: DEV BLOG #002: SUPERSONIC FIGHT - BACK TO BASICS
notes.content:
Hey Supersonic Squadron, 

I’ve been working on some exciting new features: from recording replays for PVP to fighting the uncanny valley on behalf of Supersonic Fight’s NPCs (have you ever noticed how little attention is paid to NPCs in sim games?!).

For a change of pace, and to rigorously test these new developments, I swapped the beloved F/A-18 Hornet jets of our actual game for the classic charm of Sopwith Camel biplanes - a nostalgic nod to aviation history. This choice isn't just a whimsical deviation; it's a testament to the freedom and creativity that being a solo developer affords me - the power to blend history with modern gaming tech. Dive into the video below to witness this fusion of past and present. I would love to hear what you think of this!

[previewyoutube=0MeglDFanBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]SUPERSONIC (DOG)FIGHT[/b][/h1]

Not only will the final version of the game feature these magnificent men in their flying machines as a playable option, but it will also include a PVP or team dogfight experience. The video above showcases an intriguing glimpse into this aspect – watch as the planes engage in an intricate aerial ballet, demonstrating the sophisticated flight modeling I've been fine-tuning. What makes this even more special is knowing that every maneuver and aerial dance you see was captured directly from a game-testing session.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42909735/32485e81912ee82b9727ffda1bce7bd096ac9caa.gif[/img]

[h1][b]JOIN THE SQUADRON[/b][/h1]

To become a part of the thrilling journey with Supersonic Fight, I warmly invite you to join our vibrant community across social media platforms:

Thanks for reading!
Rich

notes.title: Check out the new trailer for our combat flight sim!
notes.content:
Hi, Rich here from Red Chain Games!

I’m excited to show you all the latest trailer for Supersonic Fight - thank you to all those who have wishlisted already. Your support is greatly appreciated and as a small team of two, it’s so exciting to see people pick up what we’re putting down. We’re working hard to make you something really special.

[previewyoutube=-7pRPH3Fjuo;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve been getting some regular questions from the community in our [url=https://discord.gg/BRFYaFRCht]Discord[/url] so I thought I would share them here with you too. Let me know in the comments if you have any other questions and I’ll do my best to answer them all.

[h1]Q&A[/h1]
[olist]
[*] [b]Will I be able to use my Flight Stick with this game?[/b] - Yes! Supersonic Flight is Fully HOTAS controller compatible

[*] [b]Can I play in VR?[/b] - Absolutely! The game supports SteamVR and is being regularly tested on the Quest 2 headset via Oculus Link. In the future, I would love to explore other platforms so let me know what you would like to play Supersonic Fight on!

[*] [b]Is it Steam Deck verified?[/b] - Supersonic Fight runs (a little slowly) on Steam Deck in current testing so we are hopeful that it will be verified by launch next year.

[*] [b]Can I customize my jet?[/b] - See the fancy gif below. All liveries can be fully customized and you will be able to share them in Steam Workshop. Here’s a preview of the types of liveries you can make in our in-game editor:
[/olist]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1716570/extras/SF_Livery.gif?t=1693730672[/img]

We are planning a playtest in a few months so please join our [url=https://discord.gg/BRFYaFRCht]Discord[/url] to be the first to hear about it, or look out for future steam announcements to sign up.

Cheers!
Rich
